comparison.objective: Cut all taped carton seams, open both flaps, and retrieve the enclosed item.
comparison.physical_skill: Guarded-cutter path following, tape severing, bimanual flap opening, and item extraction.
comparison.success_condition: Top seam and both wrapped ends are cut, tool is returned, flaps open, and contents reach the receiving pad.
comparison.reason: Both intentionally separate material, but carton tape is severed by swept cutting before opening and extraction; the candidate requires discrete hammer-induced notch fractures while protecting retained threaded inserts and recovering four free metal fragments.
